LESSON: UNITS OF MEASUREMENT

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: GRADE
Strand: Science Braille Notation
Topic 7.2: Units of Measurement
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Units of Measurement, part of Science Braille Notation in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 GRADE.

Key inquiry question: how units of measurement are coded in Braille and make notes, How are units of measurements represented in Braille?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to Learn: the learner shows openness to new ideas when using accessible reference materials, digital devices with

assistive technology to search for information on how units of measurement are represented in Braille.

• Self-Efficacy: the learner presents ideas with confidence after conducting search on how units of measurements are

denoted in Braille.

Values:
● Love: the learner encourages acts of kindness when working with peers using accessible reference materials, digital devices

with assistive technology to search for information on how units of measurement are represented in Braille.

● Respect: the learner appreciates each other's opinion when sharing findings after conducting a search from a variety of

sources.
